daily.topThemeBody: 1EdTech's new post on trusted portable learning context sets out six principles for giving AI enough learner data to be useful while letting institutions cap what leaves the building; its public comment window is open. Ed-Fi's Indiana, Texas and Michigan stories are that principle already in production, while EdTech Magazine and THE Journal work the governance layer underneath.
